recommendation: Keep the fix. Future applied bodyStructure harmonization work can revise cardinality or guidance, but the current active Observation definition should continue to enforce mutual exclusion between the deprecated bodySite element and bodyStructure.
issue_request: FHIR-34894 was a Published/Persuasive OO R5 change request to add a 0..1 Observation.bodyStructure reference to BodyStructure together with an invariant making it mutually exclusive with Observation.bodySite.
initial_application: PR #1916 initially applied the issue: e48bf23f3e added Observation.bodyStructure and obs-8, e90ce92f2e added mapping, and d6dedaf6fc merged the work. R5 generated history also shows obs-8 and condition markers on both bodySite and bodyStructure.
additional_context: Observation and BodyStructure are active current-build resources. Later FHIR-53203 converted Observation.bodyStructure to CodeableReference(BodyStructure) and deprecated Observation.bodySite, but it did not approve concurrent use of both elements. FHIR-55603 rejected a different two-element harmonization proposal as needing more discussion, and FHIR-54843 remains Resolved - change required rather than Applied/Published in this run scope.
reconciliation: The published commit restores obs-8 in source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml, restores condition markers on Observation.bodySite and Observation.bodyStructure, and adds obs-8 invariant pass/fail XML examples.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml: restored obs-8 and condition markers on Observation.bodySite and Observation.bodyStructure.
source/observation/invariant-tests/obs-8.f1.fail.xml: added failing example with both bodySite and bodyStructure.
source/observation/invariant-tests/obs-8.p1.pass.xml: added passing example with bodySite only.
source/observation/invariant-tests/obs-8.p2.pass.xml: added passing example with bodyStructure only.

related_jiras.note: Converted Observation.bodyStructure to CodeableReference and deprecated Observation.bodySite; the later refactor removed obs-8 but did not approve using both elements together.
Resolved-No-Change ballot comment supports Observation.bodyStructure as CodeableReference, consistent with preserving the CodeableReference change while restoring only the invariant.
A later proposal for a different two-element pattern with an invariant was Resolved - No Change because further discussion was needed.
Later bodyStructure guidance/cardinality work is Resolved - change required and not yet Applied/Published for this default run scope.
